name_zh: 因纽特航海/冰雪生存大师：因纽特生存智慧与极地适应
name_en: Inuit Navigation/Ice Survival Masters: Inuit Survival Wisdom & Polar Adaptation
description_zh: 因纽特人横跨加拿大/格陵兰/阿拉斯加/楚科奇半岛，以冰屋/雪屋建筑、海豹鲸鱼全身利用、犬拉雪橇/皮艇 (qajaq/kayak)、长老口述知识在极端北极环境中生存繁衍千年。核心生存技术体系：读冰导航 (识别冰龄/厚度/裂隙/压力脊) → 冰屋建造 (螺旋拱顶/热力学稳定/通风孔) → 猎物全身利用 (皮毛衣物/脂肪燃料/骨骼工具/肌腱线) → 犬拉雪橇/皮艇机动。知识通过长老口述、师徒实操、社区共享代际传承，无书面记录却高度系统化。体现 M177 因纽特生存智慧——以"海冰即领土、全身利用伦理、口述即法律"三位一体，在零基建/零文字/极寒环境中构建完备生存操作系统。
description_en: Inuit across Canada/Greenland/Alaska/Chukotka survive millennia in extreme Arctic via igloo/snow architecture, seal/whale whole-utilization, dog sled/kayak (qajaq), elder oral knowledge. Core survival tech stack: ice-reading navigation (identify ice age/thickness/leads/pressure ridges) -> igloo construction (spiral dome/thermodynamic stability/ventilation) -> prey whole-utilization (fur clothing/blubber fuel/bone tools/sinew thread) -> dog sled/kayak mobility. Knowledge transmitted intergenerationally via elder oral teaching, apprentice practice, community sharing, zero written records yet highly systematized. Exemplifies M177 Inuit Survival Wisdom—trinity of 'sea ice as territory, whole-utilization ethics, oral as law' building complete survival OS in zero-infrastructure/zero-writing/extreme cold.
reason_zh: 因纽特生存非原始本能，而是"海冰读数+热力学建筑+生态全身利用+口述知识编码"四位一体工程体系。M177 区隔于 M176 萨米协商(议会)、M178 极地气候(工程/法律)、M154 梦境时间(澳洲)，核心在于"海冰即可读地图、冰屋即热力学精密结构、猎物零浪费伦理、长老口述即生存法典"。
reason_en: Inuit survival not primitive instinct but engineered quaternity of 'ice-reading + thermodynamic architecture + ecological whole-utilization + oral knowledge encoding'. M177 distinct from M176 Sami Consultation (parliament), M178 Polar Climate (engineering/law), M154 Dreamtime (Australia), core: 'sea ice as readable map, igloo as thermodynamic precision structure, prey zero-waste ethics, elder oral as survival codex'.
steps_zh: 读冰导航即地图：识别一年冰/多年冰/压力脊/裂隙/海豹呼吸孔，心理地图零误差穿越海冰
冰屋热力学精密建造：螺旋切块/拱顶自锁/冷沉热升通风/体热维持 0°C 内温，30 分钟建成
猎物全身利用伦理：海豹皮衣/鲸脂灯油/骨制鱼钩/肌腱缝合线/肠衣防水袋，零浪费敬畏生命
长老口述即生存法典：冰况术语 100+/狩猎路线歌谣/禁忌规范/紧急预案，社区授权长老教学
现代科技融合与传承：GPS 叠加传统路线/卫星冰图验证口述/皮艇材料现代化/青年长者配对教学
steps_en: Ice-reading as map: identify first-year/multi-year ice/pressure ridges/leads/seal breathing holes, mental map zero-error traverses sea ice
Igloo thermodynamic precision build: spiral cut blocks/self-locking dome/cold-sink-hot-rise ventilation/body heat maintains 0°C inside, 30-min build
Prey whole-utilization ethics: seal fur clothing/whale blubber lamp oil/bone fish hooks/sinew thread/intestine waterproof bags, zero waste reverence for life
Elder oral as survival codex: ice terminology 100+/hunting route songs/taboo norms/emergency protocols, community-authorized elder teaching
Modern tech fusion & transmission: GPS overlays traditional routes/satellite ice charts validate oral/kayak materials modernized/youth-elder paired teaching
expected_zh: 以"海冰读数+冰屋热力学+全身利用伦理+口述法典"四位一体，在极端北极构建零基建生存文明，为极地工程/气候适应/太空生存提供技术范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'ice-reading + igloo thermodynamics + whole-utilization ethics + oral codex' builds zero-infrastructure survival civilization in extreme Arctic, providing tech paradigm for polar engineering/climate adaptation/space survival.
case_zh: 因纽特人口 18 万+ (加/格/美/俄)；冰屋建造技艺非遗；皮艇成现代 kayak 祖型；NASA 极地训练引入因纽特生存课程；努纳武特 1999 建置实现自治。
case_en: Inuit population 180k+ (CA/GL/US/RU); igloo craft ICH; kayak ancestor of modern kayak; NASA polar training adopts Inuit survival curriculum; Nunavut 1999 established self-governance.
